## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp32, needs ~5.35 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/espnet](https://huggingface.co/espnet/owsm_ctc_v3.2_ft_1B))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --python 3.12 --with espnet --with espnet_model_zoo --with librosa python -c "from espnet2.bin.s2t_inference import Speech2Text; s=Speech2Text.from_pretrained('espnet/owsm_ctc_v3.2_ft_1B', device='cuda', lang_sym='<eng>', task_sym='<asr>'); print(' '.join(t for _, _, t in s.decode_long('audio.wav', batch_size=16)))"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/espnet](https://huggingface.co/espnet/owsm_ctc_v3.2_ft_1B)
